title: Page 5
content_zh:
因为与丁锦绣的婚姻生活并不怎么和谐，谢雍已对丁家人敬谢不敏，对再娶丁家女更是完全无意，大婚前他已命人将丁锦芸送回丁府，却没想到谢母背着他又偷偷将丁锦芸接了回来，在谢母眼中，凡是能对抗扫把星的女子都是好的。

所以今天谢雍见到丁锦芸也很意外，但这些事三言两语说不清楚，所以他也不打算对原宜之多说。

反正原宜之已经进了谢家门，成为他的妻，他就不急了，后半辈子还很长，让原宜之慢慢认识他、认清他、了解他、深爱他，是他以后持之以恒的任务。

丁锦芸屈膝向谢雍与原宜之行礼，“姐夫早安，原姐姐早安。”

丁锦芸称呼谢雍姐夫没措，但是称呼原宜之‘姐姐’就颇为奇怪了。

原宜之似笑非笑地瞥了谢雍一眼，回头看着丁锦芸道：“丁小姐是昭儿的小姨，是贵客，我当不得你叫一声姐姐，如果不嫌弃，就叫声谢夫人吧。”

原宜之性子好，在原府未出嫁前一向都是笑脸迎人，但不代表她是傻大姐，自己该维护的主权就一定要维护，现在她才是名正言顺的‘谢雍夫人’，可不会随随便便就允许觊觎自家新婚夫君的前任小姨子做‘妹妹’。

丁锦芸的小脸一白，咬了咬水润的樱唇，又屈膝蹲了蹲，才略带委屈地轻声回道：“是锦芸造次了，还请夫人见谅。”

原宜之无奈在心底叹口气，这小姑娘看起来相当坚持呢。

‘夫人’与‘谢夫人’虽然只一字之差，却代表了内外之别，谢家人才称呼当家主母为‘夫人’，而外来客人自然要冠以夫姓称呼‘谢夫人’。

丁锦芸轻轻巧巧地省略了原宜之的夫姓，显然也以谢家人自居，就像谢雍的两个妾玲珑和青黛，就要称呼原宜之‘夫人’，只是不知道丁锦芸这样称呼，她是把自己放在什么位置上了？

第2章(2)

一直被冷落在旁边的谢昭，在丁锦芸的暗示下跪下磕头，道：“儿子给父亲请安，给……母亲请安。”

刚刚五岁的小家伙，说话倒是挺俐落，只是声音很小，似乎有点胆怯，给原宜之磕头的时候，还偷偷抬起头看了看原宜之。

谢雍道：“起来吧，今日大人们还要忙，你好好待在自己院子里，晚上我再去问问你的功课。”

谢昭眼睛一亮，高兴地望着谢雍，似乎想走到他面前，但是看了看坐在谢雍身边的原宜之，又怯怯地停住，只是欢喜地对谢雍道：

“爹爹晚上会来看昭昭？”谢雍点点头。

谢昭高兴地扭了扭头，又拽住丁锦芸的手，仰起小脸看自家小姨，一副心满意足的模样。

原宜之看着谢昭的样子，更是心软，小家伙显然很想亲近自己的父亲，谢雍稍微一点亲善的表示，都让他很是快乐。

说起来没了亲娘的孩子总是难免可怜，原宜之对谢昭那存有的一点点忌讳也都烟消云散了。

她既然已经成为这孩子的继母，就算无法像亲娘一样疼爱他，但是把他照顾得吃饱穿暖，妥妥帖帖，应该还是可以的吧？

原宜之示意和烟取来早就为谢昭准备好的见面礼，除了她亲手缝制的衣服鞋袜，还有一件和滇白玉镶嵌足金纹饰的平安长命锁，比谢昭脖子上戴的纯金锁要小巧，但显然要贵重许多。

人们对于继母的最大担忧，恐怕就是她会不会虐待前妻留下的孩子，原宜之希望用这个长命锁表达出自己足够的善意——她希望这个孩子平安健康长命百岁。

谢雍似乎对这个白玉锁也很感兴趣，特意拿起来在掌心玩弄了一番，才把谢昭叫到跟前，亲自取下他脖子上的黄金锁，为他换上白玉锁。

白玉锁比黄金锁要轻许多，谢昭觉得脖子上轻便了，也很高兴，对着原宜之怯怯地道：“谢谢母亲，昭昭很喜欢。”

原宜之微笑，“乖，喜欢就好。”

站立在一旁的丁锦芸，看着他们母慈子孝父端肃的一家三口，紧紧咬着的樱唇都有些泛白，越发显得楚楚可怜。

丁锦芸听丁锦绣提过，谢昭脖子上的黄金锁笨拙粗重，虽然足金，但花样纹饰都明显已经陈旧过时，丁锦绣本不喜欢，却因为是谢雍给谢昭准备的礼物，为了讨好丈夫，就一直为谢昭戴着，一直戴到今天，没想到原宜之刚进门，姐夫就轻易把这‘旧物’给替换了。

这才是新娘子进门第一天，长此以往下去，丁锦绣在谢家留下的痕迹迟早会彻底被抹去吧？谢昭能否平安长大也难说吧？

丁锦芸暗暗握紧小拳头，为了不辜负姐姐的嘱托，为了保护可爱的小外甥，她也要在谢家坚持下去。

一定要坚持下去！

因为谢昭的缘故，原宜之与谢雍拜见谢母的时辰就稍微晚了些，自然又被谢母冷脸以对。

原宜之满心无奈，她知道自己不被谢母喜欢，但是像这样处处被人冷待，她再好的性子也难免心中起火，她脸上的笑容渐渐收起，只是淡然地该磕头就磕头，该敬茶就敬茶，该上香就上香，礼仪做足，一点不错，也就足够了。

用热脸贴人冷屁股的事，她不会做，更不会犯贱地去委屈讨好谁。

祭祀完祖先，回到谢府的主院时，天已近午，原宜之刚刚坐下喝口水，喘口气，小丫鬟就进来报两位姨娘来拜见新主母。

原宜之忍不住叹了口气，用手指揉了揉隐隐作痛的额头，昨天一整天的辛苦，晚上又几乎熬夜没睡，今日一大早梳洗后又忙乱到现在，她又累又烦躁，心里说不出的委屈。

她以为自己已经做好了足够的心理准备，要孝顺苛刻的婆婆，要善待前妻留下的嫡子，要尽量与早就收纳的小妾和平相处，可是事到临头，她才发现自己不是圣人，她很难受，很烦闷，很想用什么方式发泄一下。

原宜之的陪嫁奶娘孙嬷嬷是个矮小清瘦的妇人，最是通达人情世故，一看自家小姐脸色不好，便明白她已经忍耐到了尽头，急忙从背后轻轻掐了原宜之的胳膊，小声道：“我的好小姐，暂且再忍耐一下，平安顺利地过去前三天再说。”

新妇回门之前，大婚的礼仪其实都不算完成，所以孙嬷嬷无论如何也不希望小姐在这三天之内闹脾气耍性子。

这三天就是小姐和谢府家人较劫的重要时刻，而嫁进谢府做人儿媳做人继母的原宜之，本来就处在弱势地位，一切言行举止都有人等着挑错，等着看笑话，搞不好还有人巴布得‘扫把星’再克死新夫呢。

所以，原宜之不管再怎么委屈难过，再怎么想哭，也一定要忍住，要稳住。

而且原宜之的行为不仅代表她个人，还代表了原家的教养，临出嫁前原家主母郑氏还特意交代过孙嬷嬷一定要看管好小姐，千万不能丢了原家的脸面。

原府作为原宜之的娘家人，自然不会让她受人欺负，但前提是原宜之自己就能撑起门面，原家没有胡乱插手谢家日常生活的道理。只有原宜之遇到大事，她自己对付不了时，原家才可以名正言顺地出手相助。

原宜之疲惫地再揉了揉眉心，想说句什么，此时在内室换好衣服的谢雍走了出来，看她满脸疲惫，问道：“累了？传饭吧，下午你好好休息一下。”

原宜之抬头看看谢雍，见他眼底也有淡淡的青痕，意识到他和自己一样疲倦，作为男主人他更需要统筹全局，要在前庭招待宾客喝酒应酬，估计比她还辛苦，原宜之亲手为他奉上一杯清茗，问：“是否需要去娘那边伺候？”
content_en:
Because his marriage to Ding Jinxiu was not very harmonious, Xie Yong was insensitive to the Ding family, and he had no intention of marrying another daughter of the Ding family. Before the wedding, he had ordered someone to send Ding Jinyun back to the Ding mansion, but he did not expect Xie's mother to secretly take Ding Jinyun back behind his back. In Xie's eyes, any woman who can stand up to the broom star is good.

So Xie Yong was surprised to see Ding Jinyun today, but he couldn't explain these things in a few words, so he didn't plan to say much to Yuan Yizhi.

Anyway, Yuan Yizhi had already entered the Xie family and became his wife, so he was not in a hurry. The second half of his life was still very long, and letting Yuan Yizhi slowly get to know him, recognize him clearly, understand him, and love him deeply was his persistent task in the future.

Ding Jinyun knelt down and saluted Xie Yong and Yuan Yizhi, "Good morning, brother-in-law, good morning sister Yuan."

Ding Jinyun was embarrassed to call Xie Yong brother-in-law, but it was quite strange to call Yuan Yizhi 'sister'.

Yuan Yizhi glanced at Xie Yong with a half-smile, then looked back at Ding Jinyun and said, "Miss Ding is Zhao'er's aunt and an honored guest. I don't deserve you to call her sister. If you don't mind, just call her Mrs. Xie."

Yuan Yizhi has a good temper, and she always greeted people with a smile before she got married. However, this does not mean that she is a stupid eldest sister. She must safeguard her sovereignty. Now she is the legitimate "Mrs.

Ding Jinyun's little face turned pale, she bit her moist cherry lips, then bent down and squatted down, and then softly replied with a hint of grievance: "It's Jinyun's fault. Please forgive me, madam."

Yuan Yizhi sighed helplessly in his heart. This little girl seemed quite persistent.

Although there is only one word difference between ‘Madam’ and ‘Mrs.

Ding Jinyun delicately omitted Yuan Yizhi's husband's surname, and obviously regarded herself as a member of the Xie family, just like Xie Yong's two concubines, Linglong and Qingdai, would call Yuan Yizhi 'Mrs.', but I don't know what position Ding Jinyun put herself in when she called her like this?

Chapter 2(2)

Xie Zhao, who had been left out in the cold, knelt down and kowtowed at Ding Jinyun's suggestion, saying: "My son pays regards to his father, and pays regards to... his mother."

The little guy who was just five years old spoke quite lucidly, but his voice was very low and he seemed a little timid. When he kowtowed to Yuan Yizhi, he secretly raised his head and looked at Yuan Yizhi.

Xie Yong said: "Get up. The adults are still busy today. You should stay in your yard. I will ask you about your homework in the evening."

Xie Zhao's eyes lit up and he looked at Xie Yong happily, as if he wanted to walk in front of him, but after looking at Yuan Yizhi who was sitting next to Xie Yong, he timidly stopped and just said to Xie Yong happily:

"Daddy will come to see Zhaozhao tonight?" Xie Yong nodded.

Xie Zhao turned his head happily, grabbed Ding Jinyun's hand again, raised his little face to look at his aunt, looking satisfied.

Yuan Yizhi looked at Xie Zhao and felt even softer. The little guy obviously wanted to get close to his father, and Xie Yong's slightest gesture of kindness made him very happy.

Speaking of children who have lost their mother, it is always pitiful. The little taboo Yuan Yizhi had towards Xie Zhao was gone.

Now that she has become this child's stepmother, even if she can't love him as much as her own mother, she should be able to take care of him well and take care of him properly, right?

Yuan Yizhi signaled He Yan to get the meeting gifts that she had prepared for Xie Zhao. In addition to the clothes and socks she had sewn by herself, there was also a safe and longevity lock made of Yunnan white jade inlaid with pure gold patterns. It was smaller than the pure gold lock worn on Xie Zhao's neck, but obviously much more valuable.

People's biggest worry about their stepmother is probably whether she will abuse the child left by her ex-wife. Yuan Yizhi hopes to use this longevity lock to express her sufficient goodwill - she hopes that the child will be safe, healthy and live a long life.

Xie Yong seemed to be very interested in this white jade lock. He picked it up and played with it in his palm. Then he called Xie Zhao to him, personally took off the gold lock from his neck and replaced it with a white jade lock.

The white jade lock was much lighter than the gold lock. Xie Zhao felt lighter on his neck and was very happy. He said timidly to Yuan Yizhi: "Thank you, mother. Zhao Zhao likes it very much."

Yuan Yizhi smiled, "Be good, just like it."

Ding Jinyun, who was standing aside, looked at the family of three with a loving mother, a filial son, and a solemn father. Her tightly biting lips turned white, and she looked even more pitiful.

Ding Jinyun heard Ding Jinxiu mention that the gold lock around Xie Zhao's neck was clumsy and heavy. Although it was pure gold, the patterns and patterns were obviously outdated. Ding Jinxiu didn't like it at first, but because it was a gift prepared by Xie Yong for Xie Zhao, in order to please her husband, she kept wearing it for Xie Zhao and has worn it to this day. Unexpectedly, as soon as Yuan Yizhi came in, her brother-in-law easily replaced this 'old thing'.

This is the bride's first day in the house. If things go on like this, sooner or later the traces left by Ding Jinxiu in the Xie family will be completely erased, right?It’s hard to say whether Xie Zhao can grow up safely, right?

Ding Jinyun secretly clenched her little fists. In order to live up to her sister's instructions and to protect her cute little nephew, she had to persist in the Xie family.

Be sure to keep at it!

Because of Xie Zhao, Yuan Yizhi and Xie Yong were a little late to visit Xie's mother, and were naturally treated coldly by Xie's mother.

Yuan Yizhi was helpless. She knew that she was not liked by Xie's mother, but being treated coldly like this, no matter how good-tempered she was, she would inevitably get angry. The smile on her face gradually faded, and she just kowtowed indifferently when she needed to, served tea when she needed to offer tea, and offered incense when she wanted to. If she had enough etiquette, it was enough.

She wouldn't do anything like touching someone's cold butt with a hot face, let alone try to please someone in a cowardly manner.

After offering sacrifices to their ancestors, they returned to the main courtyard of the Xie Mansion. It was almost noon. Yuan Yizhi had just sat down to take a sip of water and take a breath when the little maid came in to report that the two aunts had come to pay homage to the new mistress.

Yuan Yizhi couldn't help but sigh and rubbed her aching forehead with her fingers. She had worked hard all day yesterday, almost stayed up late at night, and was busy after washing up early this morning. She was tired and irritable, and she felt unspeakably aggrieved.

She thought she had made enough psychological preparations to be filial to her demanding mother-in-law, to be kind to the legitimate son left behind by her ex-wife, and to try her best to live in peace with the concubine she had taken in long ago. But when things came to pass, she realized that she was not a saint. She felt very uncomfortable and bored, and wanted to vent her anger in some way.

Yuan Yizhi's nanny, Grandma Sun, was a short, thin woman who was very knowledgeable about the world. When she saw her young lady's face, she knew that she had reached the end of her patience. She hurriedly pinched Yuan Yizhi's arm from behind and whispered: "My good lady, please be patient for a little longer. We'll talk about it three days later if everything goes by safely and smoothly."

The wedding etiquette is not completed until the bride returns home, so Grandma Sun does not want the young lady to lose her temper within these three days.

These three days are an important moment for the young lady and the Xie family. Yuan Yizhi, who married into the Xie family as a daughter-in-law and stepmother, is already in a weak position. In every word and deed, there are people waiting to find fault, waiting to see the joke. Maybe there will be someone who can kill the new husband again.

Therefore, no matter how wronged and sad Yuan Yizhi is, no matter how much he wants to cry, he must hold back and be steady.

Moreover, Yuan Yizhi's behavior not only represented her personally, but also represented the upbringing of the Yuan family. Before getting married, the mistress of the Yuan family, Mrs. Zheng, specifically told Grandma Sun to take good care of the young lady and never lose the face of the Yuan family.

As Yuan Yizhi's natal family, the Yuan family will naturally not let her be bullied, but the premise is that Yuan Yizhi can support the facade by herself. The Yuan family has no reason to interfere in the daily life of the Xie family.Only when Yuan Yizhi encounters a big problem that she can't handle herself, can the Yuan family justifiably help.

Yuan Yizhi rubbed the center of his brow tiredly again, wanting to say something. At this time, Xie Yong, who had changed his clothes in the inner room, came out. Seeing her tired face, he asked: "Tired? Pass the food. You can have a good rest in the afternoon."

Yuan Yizhi looked up at Xie Yong and saw that there were faint blue marks under his eyes. She realized that he was just as tired as herself. As the host, he needed to coordinate the overall situation. He had to entertain guests in the front yard to drink and socialize. It was probably harder than her. Yuan Yizhi personally served him a cup of tea and asked, "Do I need to go to mother's side to serve him?"
